decision.rule: D3 (E2_PLAN.md, written before the runs): adopt a tuned finalist only if, on the confirm slice (6,000,000-6,000,099 x 3 tilts, 60 s), (a) its paired per-scenario median-cost ratio to model-based has a 95% bootstrap CI entirely below 1, and (b) McNemar does not show more falls. 'Shows more falls' := the finalist fell in more discordant scenarios than model-based (only_this_fell > only_reference_fell, i.e. more falls in total on the same scenarios) AND the exact two-sided McNemar p < 0.05. Otherwise model-based. If several finalists qualify, the one with the lowest DEV objective is adopted: the confirm tier accepts or rejects, it never chooses among candidates. No multiplicity correction across finalists.
decision.why: no finalist qualifies under D3, so the reference is model-based
